stage: Before DES design results; only released CID/IDSURVEY/zHD/zHEL/MUERR_FINAL and covariance are read. No MU or observed distance residual is read/scored.
estimand: Relative total standardized-luminosity/opacity/calibration/selection drift: r_DES(z)-5log10[(DM/rd)/z], with one free common magnitude/ruler intercept. Future r_DES=MU-5log10[(1+zHEL)zHD], but MU is not loaded here.
assumptions: Published DES distances have MUERR_FINAL statistical/BEAMS uncertainty; STAT+SYS matrix contains additional systematic covariance. Use C=systematic matrix+diag(MUERR_FINAL^2) exactly once, as release README and SN-only likelihood specify; STATONLY is zero and not added. Constant comoving ruler, standard distance duality, released Gaussian effective-redshift BAO approximation, unknown cross-probe covariance taken zero for forecast only. No LCDM fit, H0 or rd calibration.
selection: Read DES-SN5YR_HD.csv in exact file order, restrict IDSURVEY==10 without sorting or magnitude-dependent cuts; preserve the corresponding full-matrix row indices. Check selected CID/redshift/uncertainty against HD+MetaData in identical release order. DES zHD is interpolation coordinate; zHEL enters only the unscored future geometric expression. BAO DM nodes inside DES zHD support; exclude DV and DH, use marginal DM covariance submatrix.
interpolation: Local GLS polynomial in [ln(1+z)-ln(1+z_node)]/halfwidth, primary degree2 halfwidth.10. Frozen sensitivities degree2 widths.075,.125 and degree3 width.10. Marginal local C in each GLS; cross-node errors from W Cfull W^T. No kernel tuning with outcomes.
admission: For every frozen interpolation design: >=20 distinct CID, >=5 distinct CID strictly each side, full polynomial rank, condition number<1e8, max named-test-curve interpolation bias<=.005mag. Interpolation tests are a finite sensitivity set, not a bound over arbitrary smooth histories.
recovery_curves: Flat constant-w Om in[.15,.3,.5], w in[-1.5,-1,-.5]; positive kinematic E=(1+z)^(1+q0+q1)exp[-q1*z/(1+z)], q0 in[-1,0,.5], q1 in[0,1,2]. Test r=5log10[(integral dz/E)/z]. Curves test approximation only, not priors or fits.
power: If >=2 nodes admitted, estimate Gaussian forecast SE for drift linear in ln(1+z) normalized to1 between min/max admitted nodes. Profile intercept. Power at two-sided5% for endpoint differences .02,.05,.10mag. Retain inter-node SN covariance. BAO log delta-method approximation verified with50000 Gaussian draws, seed260926117.
stop: Do not score observed drift in this script. This DES branch shares supernovae/analysis ancestry with other released compilations and is not an independent-dataset multiplication with Pantheon+. Broad BAO redshift kernels are unresolved; interpolation recovery alone does not validate compressed likelihood under arbitrary histories. No opacity attribution or cosmology correction.
